summary: AES filed an 8-K updating that it received CFIUS approval for its pending merger with Horizon Parent, L.P., announced March 1, 2026. Merger Sub will merge into AES, with AES surviving as a privately held company jointly owned by Global Infrastructure Management, EQT Infrastructure VI, and other investors. Closing remains subject to other regulatory approvals and customary conditions. The filing provides no price per share, premium, or break fee. This is a going-private transaction. Watch for remaining regulatory clearances and timing of closing.
